plan_adapter.initialization_rule: load saved byte-identical initial adapter AND prefix, then reset training RNG

plan_phases.name: phase2
plan_phases.initialization: same-arm final phase1 adapter AND prefix; no optimizer/scheduler resume

point_sampling.implementation_note: Existing hybrid implementation selects FPS for even seeds; seed 42 therefore uses FPS, not a realized 50/50 mixture
point_sampling.cache_rule: one immutable vector/point sample per source split, ID and modality; share across arms and phases

stage4b.initialization: same shared Stage4 adapter for both arms, new optimizer/scheduler
stage4b.plan_source: same-arm FINAL phase2 model, train-only predicted-role IDs
stage4b.plan_canonicalization: P1a, including identity/empty outcome; log all outcomes
stage4b.validation_source: data/25k/val.jsonl, fixed original 2500 GT-plan STEP rows

runtime_assertions: Verify frozen manifest, source resource, script, initialization and shared checkpoint hashes before any training
Materialize frozen query cache without skipping; all latent vectors finite, exact ID-modality coverage, identical cache used by both arms
Abort for missing/empty reference targets, encoding failures or sample-ID/order mismatch
After tokenization every training case must retain at least one supervised target token; abort without dropping a row
Check installed Trainer planned max_steps and traverse counts before each real run
Assert actual final global_step 4689, 500, 1182 and save it in each final training report
Check final adapter and prefix both come from the final step; no best/final mixing
Record unchanged LR vector hash, fresh optimizer state and phase seed reset on both arms
Require all 3150 Stage4b rows even when predicted-plan text is invalid/empty
Abort on nonempty output directory or implicit resume; never overwrite a partial training run
limitations: Single paired seed: no estimate of training-seed variance
Exposure policy changes cumulative modality totals; not a pure order-only ablation
Matched re-run with step-budget normalization, not byte-for-byte historical training reproduction
Equal case presentations and update counts do not imply equal token exposure or GPU time
CPU planning is not an observed trained global_step
Preparation does not authorize training; manifest-aware training entrypoint still needs separate audit
